# How a monthly statement is laid out

A monthly statement is one PDF per customer per month. Its first page lists the month's statement
lines: every invoice issued in the month, every credit note, and every payment received. The last
line of the statement is the balance still due at the end of the month. A statement is sent as a
PDF attachment and kept for seven years.
